@returns One of the addresses found by the last [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs), as a number for [DottedIP](DottedIP).
@param host_index  The address to take, counting from 1.
@gap Without a call of [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs) the addresses of this computer are used. Only IPv4 addresses are returned, and an index past the last one returns 0.
